boundaries: All amounts are forward simulations; arithmetic audit is not empirical validation.
Case counts are parameter rows, not independent jobs, experiments, probabilities or market weights.
The provider's USD25000 starting cash is not the earlier combined provider/customer USD25000 resource budget.
Twelve operating months follow paid setup; this is not a twelve-calendar-month launch promise.
Complete provider expense includes processing; refunds are contra-revenue; tax reserves are retained cash restrictions.
Evidence-pack human productive durations are assumptions; the USD200 alternative is a separate hypothesis with unknown human duration.
Annual-demand comparisons charge full fallback for failed and unserved requests, subject to explicit staffing limits or unknowns.
Earmarked balances are not construction spending. All primary cases spend zero on candidate construction and executor additions.
Four-times-demand simulated gains are frozen assumptions and do not establish observed capability, extra accepted capacity or self-acceleration.
Token valuations, liquidity and gas are scenarios. No token proceeds enter the ordinary-USD cash model.
Historical authoring and material downstream liability remain unknown, not zero.
